@graph.rdfs:comment: Quality hold notice identified by its exact QH-number.
Incoming sensor material lot identified by its exact SL-number, never by part number.
Intermediate assembly lot identified by its exact AL-number.
Finished production lot identified by its exact FL-number, never by product model.
Warehouse shipment identified by its exact SH-number.
Customer receiving site. Use the exact CS-number alone as the canonical name; a site name is only contextual.
A confirmed quality hold applies to this particular sensor lot.
A sensor lot was actually consumed in an assembly lot, not merely planned.
An assembly lot was used to produce a completed finished lot.
A finished lot or part of it was actually loaded and dispatched on the shipment.
The shipment has a confirmed signed delivery at the customer site. Never derive delivery from dispatch or the absence of a receipt.
